Homepage.quote: Not all those who wander are lost.
Homepage.aboutQuote1: "Just a guy who loves code, coffee, and getting lost in new cities. Sharing the raw, messy, and beautiful moments of my travels. Join me as I discover the world one commit at a time."
Homepage.aboutQuote2: Whether traversing the bustling streets of Tokyo or finding serenity in the Swiss Alps, I believe every journey writes a new function in the codebase of our lives. I build scalable software systems by day, and hunt for the world's best espresso by night.

About.introText: I build software that matters by day and chase sunsets across continents by heart. This is where both worlds meet — a space for code, curiosity, and the places that shape who I am.
About.engineerP1: I am a 24-year-old software engineer based in Bangalore, where I spend my days architecting elegant solutions to complex problems. Technology isn't just my profession — it's the lens through which I understand the world.
About.engineerP2: Every line of code is a decision. Every system design is a philosophy. I believe that the best software is invisible — it simply works, and works beautifully, without demanding attention.
About.travelerP1: Beyond the screen, I am a seeker of real experiences. I realized early on that while code builds the virtual world, travel connects us to the living one. Every destination has rewired something in me.
About.travelQuote: "The world is a book and those who do not travel read only one page."
About.travelerP2: This blog is a curated record of those journeys — where every destination carries a story and every photograph holds a moment I refused to let slip away. You just have to be still enough to listen.
About.footerText: Thanks for stopping by and being part of my journey.
